summary: Customer reported unauthorized withdrawal; agent froze account and filed report.

intents.keywords: I am worried my savings account shows of withdrawal...someone stealing my money.

issues.reason(s): Customer did not authorize the transaction.

intents.actions of agent: Confirmed transaction details, froze the account, filed a fraud report, and assured the customer of fund recovery.
intents.Process Request: Fraud report filing and transaction reversal.
intents.resolution: The agent assured the customer that the transaction would be reversed within 5 to 7 days.
